The preparation process of LCO ASSLIB is the same as that of LMRO. For the LCO cathode, its suitable discharge voltage is 3.0 V. If the discharge cut-off voltage is reduced to 2.0 V, it will lead to the over-insertion of lithium in the LCO, which is not conducive to the cycle performance of ASSLIB.
